# Shure  collaboration  technology

The most trusted manufacturers of audio equipment worldwide

Scroll to bottom of the hero section

![MXA902 Lifestyle Medium Room](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/MXA902_Lifestyle_Medium_Room_High_4_Talent.png)

### Leader in acoustics, audio, and wireless technology

With over 100 years of expertise in acoustics, wireless technology, and audio engineering, Shure empowers great communicators to be heard with confidence. Whether it’s a keynote address, a virtual meeting, or a collaborative session, our solutions are designed to make every word count.

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/shure/#contact)

## Real-Time Design with Shure

Experience how to validate your Shure room designs before you build them. No headset or specialty hardware needed!

[Schedule a VR demo](https://avispl.com/shure/#contact)

![MXCW MXCW640 Model 3](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/MXCW_MXCW640_Model3_Wide.png)

### Application Solutions

- **Conference & Discussion:** When critical information is exchanged, precision and reliability are non-negotiable. Shure’s conferencing microphones deliver exceptional clarity, ensuring every voice is heard—clearly and confidently. Whether you’re in a boardroom or a council chamber, Shure empowers seamless communication.
- **Education:** The classroom has evolved. With hybrid learning models and remote instruction now the norm, great audio is essential for inclusive, effective education. Shure’s solutions are designed to support educators and students alike—whether in-person, online, or both—so learning never misses a beat.
- **Presentation:** From keynote speeches to executive briefings, commanding attention starts with being heard. Shure’s advanced voice solutions bring studio-quality clarity to your presentations, helping you engage audiences and deliver your message with impact.

![Modern conference room: long wooden tables, gray chairs, wall-mounted screens. Windows and wood panels add warmth; greenery outside.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Cisco-241017_Dual-Space_Training-Mtg_Room-Heimdall_DELIVERY-resized.jpg)

### Solutions

AVI-SPL and Shure work together to transform ideas into great customer experiences. As one of the most trusted manufacturers of audio equipment worldwide, Shure provides sound solutions for every need – from conferencing, to educational institutions, to government facilities, and professional sound installations.

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/shure/#contact)

[![Shure Extraordinary Audio](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Shure-Extraordinary-Audio.jpg)](https://player.vimeo.com/video/1217028815?autoplay=1)

### Meet The Bar That Removes Barriers

With Shure’s All-in-one Video Conference Bar, the IntelliMix™️ Bar Pro Kit, superior sound meets intelligent video and effortless control.

- Microsoft Teams Certified for medium to large collaboration spaces with this powerful all-in-one Android based video conference bar.
- IntelliMix Processing delivers unparalleled sound quality with AI-enhanced echo-, noise- and reverb-free audio for


every space to minimize distractions in active meetings.
- 4K AI-powered cameras with 135 degrees of wide-angle coverage and telephoto lenses clearly capture everyone in the room.
- Comprehensive security practices for Android based on Microsoft Device Ecosystem Platform (MDEP).
- The IntelliMix Bar Pro combines patented Shure array microphones and high output, premium stereo loudspeakers in an


efficient, single device.

##### Microflex Ecosystem

Designed for the most demanding spaces, Shure Microflex Ecosystem offers endlessly flexible networked audio solutions. From microphones to DSPs to loudspeakers, tailor your setup for best-in-class collaboration experiences in any room.

##### MXW neXt (2/4/8 channel)

All-in-one audio solution for hybrid classrooms, training rooms, and flexible meeting spaces. With effortless setup, powerful wireless performance, and scalable design, it delivers clear, reliable sound—wherever collaboration happens.

##### IntelliMix™️ Room Kits

Boost collaboration with simple and secure Microsoft Teams Rooms or Zoom Room conferencing kits for small to large space.

##### Networked Loudspeakers

Microflex loudspeakers enhance conferencing with speech-focused sound, flexible speakers, and customization. The Microflex Ecosystem offers secure, unified management and the MXN-AMP PoE+ amplifier upgrades existing setups

##### MXA902 Ceiling Array + Loudspeaker

Automatic Coverage™ technology ensures precise audio capture without setup. Advanced array architecture enhances directional pickup and natural speech, ideal for conferencing, camera tracking, voice lift, and sound reinforcement.

##### ShureCloud

Elevate audio management with ShureCloud’s intelligent control. Optimize performance, minimize downtime via intuitive remote management, real-time monitoring, and streamlined updates for any organization size.

### Videos

[![Shure-Intellimix-Room-Kit_60s](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Shure-Intellimix-Room-Kit_60s.jpg)](https://vimeo.com/1088490578)

[![Shure_Microflex Loudspeakers](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Shure_Microflex-Loudspeakers.jpg)](https://vimeo.com/1088490956?share=copy#t=0)

[![Shure_MXCW](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Shure_MXCW.jpg)](https://avispl.com/shure/)

[![Shure_MXCW](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Shure_MXCW-.jpg)](https://vimeo.com/1088491108?share=copy#t=0)

[![Shure Networked Audio Ecosystem](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Shure-Networked-Audio-Ecosystem-.jpg)](https://vimeo.com/1088490772?share=copy#t=0)
